victoryMessage: The English Empire now dominates all of Europe. Your armies stand invincible and your remaining rivals kneel at your feet!
dscr: The kingdom of England is thriving under its new Norman rulers and is ready to conquer new lands. Isolated on an island, England enjoys a relatively secure position, with only the French posing an immediate threat.

victoryMessage: The French Empire now dominates all of Europe. Your armies stand invincible and your remaining rivals kneel at your feet!
dscr: As heirs of Charlemagne and centre of European culture, the French see it as their duty to rebuild the old Frankish empire. It will, however, take both tact and might to handle the ambitions of the neighboring Germans, English and Spanish.

victoryMessage: The German Empire now dominates all of Europe. Your armies stand invincible and your remaining rivals kneel at your feet!
dscr: The Germans see their 'Holy Roman Empire' as a righteous continuation of the ancient Roman Empire. Their potential enemies are many, but their duty is clear: to carry imperial rule ro every corner of the continent.

victoryMessage: The Byzantine Empire now dominates all of Europe. Your armies stand invincible and your remaining rivals kneel at your feet!
dscr: The Byzantines are the last remnant of the old Roman Empire, and have been in continuous decline ever since the fall of Rome. While they are now more Greek than Roman, they still yearn for their rightful place as masters of the known world.

victoryMessage: The Turkish Empire now dominates all of Europe. Your armies stand invincible and your remaining rivals kneel at your feet!
dscr: The Turks are a nomadic people from western Asia who seem destined to carve a mighty empire out of the eastern Islamic world. The Byzantines are their most dangerous foes, but once overcome there is little else that can stop them.

victoryMessage: The Arab Empire now dominates all of Europe. Your armies stand invincible and your remaining rivals kneel at your feet!
dscr: Some 400 years ago the Arabs united under the new banner of Islam and quickly came to dominate northern Africa and western Asia. Political unity has waned since then, but under a strong leader it can be restored once more.

victoryMessage: The Russian Empire now dominates all of Europe. Your armies stand invincible and your remaining rivals kneel at your feet!
dscr: The Russians reside at the heart of an incredibly vast land, filled with minor kingdoms and tribes. By the time they reach the lands of similar empires, the armies of the Tsar will truly be a force to be reckoned with.

victoryMessage: The Moorish Empire now dominates all of Europe. Your armies stand invincible and your remaining rivals kneel at your feet!
dscr: The Moorish people of northern Africa have thrived under Islam, having conquered most of Spain before being pushed back into its southern half. Despite incursions from Christian kingdoms, they remain a centre of culture and military might.

victoryMessage: The Viking Empire now dominates all of Europe. Your armies stand invincible and your remaining rivals kneel at your feet!
dscr: While the Viking age of raiding has passed, the Norse people are stronger than ever before. As neighbors of the powerful Germans, their first order of business will be to unite the Scandinavian kingdoms into a true northern empire.

victoryMessage: The Spanish Empire now dominates all of Europe. Your armies stand invincible and your remaining rivals kneel at your feet!
dscr: The Spanish have only recently achieved the unity necessary to make significant gains against the Moors. Still, no true Spaniard can rest until all of the Iberian peninsula belongs to the crown. After that the rest of the world will follow.
